parameters.name: ManagementProtocol
parameters.description: Specifies the management protocol used by the gateway.

parameters.name: EndpointID
parameters.description: The unique USP identifier for this USP Agent.

parameters.name: MACAddress
parameters.description: MAC address of the discovered device.

parameters.name: ManufacturerOUI
parameters.description: Organizationally unique identifier of the associated gateway. {{pattern}} {{empty}} indicates that there is no associated gateway that has been detected.

parameters.name: ProductClass
parameters.description: Identifier of the product class of the associated gateway. {{empty}} indicates either that there is no associated gateway that has been detected, or the gateway does not support the use of the product-class parameter.

parameters.name: SerialNumber
parameters.description: Serial number of the associated gateway. {{empty}} indicates that there is no associated gateway that has been detected.

object.description: This object contains information associated with a connected gateway.
